title: dead-letter Vec allocation before count is unnecessary
description: relay_queue.rs drain_once lines 212-219: builds a Vec<DirEntry> (heap-allocating all dead-dir entries) then immediately calls .iter().filter().count() and discards the Vec. The entries Vec is not used for anything else. A direct streaming count without collecting would avoid the allocation: increment a counter in the while-let loop without pushing to Vec. Dead-letter dir is rarely large so not a hot-path issue, but the current code reads as if the Vec is needed.
